searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keywords to match against tweet text (case-insensitive). Multiple terms are OR'd. Because X's search endpoint is closed to logged-out clients, keywords also seed account discovery — see the README on recall.

fromUsers.title: From these accounts
fromUsers.description: Handles without '@'. When supplied, the Actor makes no third-party call at all: these accounts are crawled directly on X.

toUsers.title: Replies directed at
toUsers.description: Client-side filter: keeps replies that mention these handles. There is no mention index available to logged-out clients, so this filters the crawled set rather than searching X.

mentioning.title: Mentioning
mentioning.description: Client-side filter: keeps tweets mentioning these handles.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Without '#'. Matched case-insensitively against the tweet's hashtag entities.

since.title: Since (inclusive)
since.description: ISO date or datetime, e.g. 2026-08-01. Inclusive. Applied to the tweet's Snowflake ID, so it is exact.

until.title: Until (inclusive)
until.description: ISO date or datetime. Inclusive — a bare date covers the whole day up to 23:59:59.999 UTC.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO-639-1 code, matched against X's own language detection (e.g. en, pt, es).

onlyVerified.title: Only verified authors
onlyVerified.description: X conflates paid Blue with legacy verification, so this matches either.

mediaType.title: Media type
mediaType.description: images = has at least one photo; video = has video or GIF (X stores GIFs as MP4); links = has at least one URL; text_only = no media and no links.

includeRetweets.title: Include retweets
includeRetweets.description: Excluded by default. When included, a retweet carries the original's full text and metrics — the retweet wrapper's counters are structurally zero.

sortBy.title: Sort order
sortBy.description: latest = newest first, exact (tweet IDs are monotonic). top = ranked by likes + retweets within the collected set; X's own relevance ranking is not reproducible from the logged-out surface.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: How many tweets to return. Free runs are capped at 10 results regardless of this value; the cap is enforced server-side. Paid runs receive the full amount.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxies are recommended: X rate-limits per guest token and per IP, and the Actor pins one token to one IP for the life of a session.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent accounts
maxConcurrency.description: Advanced. A single timeline's cursor chain is sequential, so parallelism happens across accounts.

maxAccounts.title: Maximum accounts to crawl
maxAccounts.description: Advanced. Upper bound on how many accounts a single run will crawl, including accounts found by seed expansion.

maxPagesPerAccount.title: Maximum pages per account
maxPagesPerAccount.description: Advanced. One page is ~20 tweets on a paginated timeline.

expansionDepth.title: Seed expansion depth
expansionDepth.description: Advanced. 0 disables snowball expansion. Mentions and retweeted authors are harvested from pages already fetched, so expansion costs no extra requests — but precision decays with depth.

maxSessions.title: Guest token pool size
maxSessions.description: Advanced. Each token is worth ~50 requests per 15 minutes. Tokens are free and instant to mint.

maxRequests.title: Request budget
maxRequests.description: Advanced. Hard ceiling on requests to X for the whole run — the cost control. Low-selectivity keyword filters can otherwise fetch thousands of tweets for a handful of matches.
